name: Python interval merging smoke calibration, repeated independent sessions

cases.task: Implement merge_intervals in intervals.py. Given integer [start, end] pairs in any order, merge ranges when they overlap or share an endpoint (next_start <= current_end); adjacent disjoint integer ranges such as [1,4] and [5,9] must remain separate, return sorted lists, and leave input unchanged. Empty input returns []. Reject reversed pairs with ValueError. Modify only intervals.py. Trial label: 1.
cases.check:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from intervals import merge_intervals
assert merge_intervals([]) == []
assert merge_intervals([[3,5],[1,3],[9,10],[2,4]]) == [[1,5],[9,10]]
assert merge_intervals([[-5,-2],[-3,0],[7,7]]) == [[-5,0],[7,7]]
x=[[5,9],[1,2],[2,4]]
assert merge_intervals(x) == [[1,4],[5,9]]
assert x == [[5,9],[1,2],[2,4]]
try: merge_intervals([[4,2]])
except ValueError: pass
else: raise AssertionError('reversed range accepted')
assert merge_intervals([[0, 3], [2, 5]]) == [[0,5]]
